_: Radiant quest alias chain (#7 findMatchingLocation + #8 findInLocationAlias), the Missives variety core: a Hold location -> a Dungeon location within that Hold -> the boss container ref within that Dungeon. The quest is StartGameEnabled here for an isolated build/inspect; a real radiant template is usually launched by a Story Manager ChangeLocation event. FormIDs verified vs Skyrim.esm 2026-06-17: LocTypeHold->0x016771 (Keyword), LocTypeDungeon->0x0130DB (Keyword), BossContainer->0x0130F8 (LocationReferenceType). CK semantics of the Location alias fields are pending main-machine xEdit compare vs a real Missives alias (see WAIT_USER).

aliases.name: Hold
aliases._: #7 LocationAlias: pick any location whose LocType keyword = a Hold. No parent -> searched broadly. LocTypeHold (verified 2026-06-17).

aliases.name: Dungeon
aliases._: #7 LocationAlias narrowed: a Dungeon-type child location WITHIN the Hold alias (@Hold). LocTypeDungeon (verified 2026-06-17).

aliases.name: BossChest
aliases._: #8 find a reference of LCRT BossContainer WITHIN the Dungeon location alias (#<LCRT>). RefType + conditions both narrow which ref fills. BossContainer LCRT (verified 2026-06-17).
